title: ETTP Identity
description: A stable, technology-independent identity record for an ETTP entity.

id.description: A globally unique, stable, non-secret identifier that does not encode personal or vendor-specific data.

version.description: The version of this identity record.

entity_type.description: An extensible entity type identifier; implementations must not assume the set is closed.

owner.description: Optional identifier or label for the entity's owner.

issuer.description: Optional identifier or label for the authority that issued this identity record.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the entity can attempt; this field does not grant authorization.

provenance.description: Optional provenance metadata. Its contents are descriptive and do not establish trust by themselves.

created_at.description: The timestamp at which this identity record was created.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for this identity record.

status.description: The lifecycle status of the identity.

extensions.description: Optional implementation-defined extension data. Extensions must not redefine ETTP protocol fields.
